bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
cd "$HOME/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot"
test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active
test "$(systemctl --user is-enabled gace-userbot-verify.service)" = enabled
test -f scripts/userbot_topic_audit_client.py
python3 scripts/userbot_topic_audit_client.py --chat-id -1002373696859 --topic-id 1605 > /tmp/video_chat_1605_audit_20261124.json
python3 scripts/userbot_topic_audit_client.py --chat-id -1003770334893 --topic-id 4 > /tmp/gay_chat_4_audit_20261124.json
python3 - <<'PY'
import json
for f,topic in [("/tmp/video_chat_1605_audit_20261124.json",1605),("/tmp/gay_chat_4_audit_20261124.json",4)]:
 raw=open(f).read().strip().split("=",1)
 if len(raw)!=2 or raw[0]!="USERBOT_TOPIC_AUDIT":raise SystemExit(62)
 obj=json.loads(raw[1])
 if obj.get("status")!="PASS" or len(obj.get("rows",[]))!=1:raise SystemExit(63)
 row=obj["rows"][0]
 if int(row.get("topic_id",-1))!=topic:raise SystemExit(64)
 print("TOPIC_VERIFIED",topic,str(row.get("title",""))[:100],str(row.get("post_button",""))[:30])
PY
test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active
echo TWO_TARGET_USERBOT_READONLY_PASS
